package.name: wojtek_agent_perf
package.description: Latency probe for Wojtek's agentic stack: a passive subscriber that turns the pipeline's message stamps into per-stage timings (ASR, router, brain, TTS, and the whole mic-to-sound wait) and writes them as the same perf.span JSONL the training-side profiler emits, so one report ranks both stacks. Adds no work to any node's callback.
